defensiveAbilities.name: Nature's Protector
defensiveAbilities.description: A karkono is intrinsically tied to a specific ecosystem, such as a coastal marsh or boreal forest on a planet. A karkono ignores difficult terrain and gains a +1 status bonus to initiative rolls while in their ecosystem. When a karkono's ecosystem is polluted or significantly damaged (for example, due to a forest fire or chemical spill), the karkono is Sickened 2 and can't reduce their sickened condition below 1. They also gain a +4 status bonus to damage rolls.

offensiveAbilities.name: Back To Nature
offensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency once per round

Effect The karkono makes a claw Strike against a creature with the tech trait, causing plant matter to explode from it. On a hit, the creature must attempt a DC 24 Reflex Saving Throw save; on a critical hit, the creature uses the outcome one degree of success worse than the result of its roll.

Failure The creature becomes glitching 1.

Critical Failure The creature becomes glitching 2.

offensiveAbilities.name: Blood Renewal
offensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency once per day

Effect The karkono performs a ritual to anoint the land in fresh blood. Plant growth springs from the ground in a 20ft Type:emanation, counting as difficult terrain. The karkono and any allied creatures within the area gain regeneration 15 (cold iron) while in the area. These effects last for 10 minutes.

Effect: Blood Renewal
